meta.description: Curated finish, foil-pattern, marking, distribution, release-date, size, and Cardmarket-product mappings that cannot be represented by TCGdex's group-level normal/holo/reverse flags.
policy: A physical stamp is recorded in markings; the way a card was distributed is recorded separately in distribution.
Printed identity features such as a rarity symbol or contest credit use role=print-identity; they do not imply a finish.
EX-era set-logo stamps that are intrinsic to the reverse-holo design use role=reverse-holo-treatment.
Prerelease, Staff, retailer, Pokemon Center, and similar later stamps use role=distribution-promo and do not imply reverse holo.
An override applies only where its mapped Cardmarket variant exists for the language, unless mappedVariants is empty.
Only a source marked coverage=complete-manifest may support a claim that a listed alternative is absent inside its explicit closureScope; API and marketplace records are positive-only.
PSA certification and registry records confirm named varieties only; population counts and omissions never prove that another variety is absent.

pokemon-cn-simplified-finish-rules.sourceType: Official Mainland China Simplified Chinese card-finish guide
pokemon-cn-simplified-finish-rules.evidence: The official guide states that cards of rarity R and above are foil cards produced with mirror processing, and that Simplified Chinese C, U and R cards can be pulled as the locality-specific patterned random foil treatment. It does not state that these are the only printings.

pokemon-cn-shining-synergy-starter.sourceType: Official Mainland China Simplified Chinese product specification
pokemon-cn-shining-synergy-starter.evidence: The official Shining Synergy GX starter-deck specification states that all 60 constructed-deck cards, drawn from its named 351-card pool, are 平卡 (non-holo).

pokemon-cn-dynamax-clash-starter.sourceType: Official Mainland China Simplified Chinese product specification
pokemon-cn-dynamax-clash-starter.evidence: The official Dynamax Clash specification states that all 60 cards in each constructed starter deck are 平卡 (non-holo), and that the Deck Building Box includes one random Pokémon V 闪卡 (foil card).

pokemon-cn-primordial-arts-starter.sourceType: Official Mainland China Simplified Chinese product specification
pokemon-cn-primordial-arts-starter.evidence: The official Primordial Arts V starter-deck specification states that all 60 constructed-deck cards, drawn from its named 178-card pool, are 平卡 (non-holo).

pokemon-cn-gallant-galaxy-starter.sourceType: Official Mainland China Simplified Chinese product specification
pokemon-cn-gallant-galaxy-starter.evidence: The official Gallant Galaxy V starter-deck specification states that all 60 constructed-deck cards, drawn from its named 160-card pool, are 平卡 (non-holo).

pokemon-cn-battle-party-flat-and-foil.sourceType: Official Mainland China Simplified Chinese product specification
pokemon-cn-battle-party-flat-and-foil.evidence: The official Battle Party specification describes ordinary and foil packs with the same card contents and different processing, positively establishing both flat and foil copies of each included deck card.

pokemon-cn-battle-party-dream-decks.sourceType: Official Mainland China Simplified Chinese product specification
pokemon-cn-battle-party-dream-decks.evidence: The official product specification states that Shared Dream has fourteen flat-card decks plus one foil Mewtwo deck and Shining Dream has eighteen flat-card decks plus two foil decks; the corresponding flat and foil decks have identical card contents and differ only in processing.

pokemon-cn-happy-set-1-decks.sourceType: Official Mainland China Simplified Chinese product specification
pokemon-cn-happy-set-1-decks.evidence: The official first Happy Set specification positively describes the same constructed-deck contents in ordinary and foil processing, establishing both flat and foil copies for cards in the paired deck.

pokemon-cn-happy-set-4-decks.sourceType: Official Mainland China Simplified Chinese product specification
pokemon-cn-happy-set-4-decks.evidence: The official fourth Happy Set specification positively describes ordinary and foil versions with the same constructed-deck contents and different processing.

pokemon-cn-departure-special-pack.sourceType: Official Mainland China Simplified Chinese product specification
pokemon-cn-departure-special-pack.evidence: The official Departure Special Pack specification states that the second card can be a newly included Pokémon special-illustration 闪卡; SPEC-0154 establishes the exact CSVL1C 109/049 Snorlax special-illustration identity.

pokumon-s-p-cs-061.evidence: Pokumon's exact Simplified-Chinese 061/S-P Snorlax record identifies the Tournament Participation printing as Non-holo.

pokumon-id-svp278.evidence: The exact 278/SV-P Indonesian promo record identifies the July 25, 2025 Gym Promo Pack 11 card as Non-holo.

pokumon-id-svp286.evidence: The exact 286/SV-P Indonesian promo record identifies the January-February 2026 Taro card as Non-holo.

pokumon-th-svp082.evidence: The exact Thai 082/SV-P record positively identifies the Central Pattana Great Celebration distribution, event stamp and Non-holo treatment.
